Tata Technologies, on display at the 2012 [[North American International Auto Show]]]] Tata Technologies was founded in 1989, as the [[automotive design]] unit of [[Tata Motors]].{{cite news |title=Tata Tech eyes $250m buys to hit $1bn sales |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/tata-tech-eyes-250m-buys-to-hit-1bn-sales/articleshow/46337156.cms |access-date=11 May 2023 |work=The Times of India |date=23 February 2015}} It was hived off as a separate company in 1994, with Tata Motors continuing to hold a [[majority stake]] and be its biggest client.{{cite news |title=PEs vie for $520 million Tata Tech stake |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/PEs-vie-for-520-million-Tata-Tech-stake/articleshow/47006986.cms |access-date=11 May 2023 |work=The Times of India |date=22 April 2015}} Tata Technologies Inc acquired INCAT International, a UK-and US-based automotive and aerospace engineering company, in August 2005 for £53.4 million.{{cite web|title=Tatas to acquire INCAT International|url=http://ia.rediff.com/money/2005/aug/18tata1.htm|work=Rediff|accessdate=21 January 2013|date=18 August 2005}} In 2011, Tata Technologies raised {{INR}}141 crore (US$30 million) by selling 13% stake to [[Tata Capital]] and [[Mizuho Securities|Alpha TC Holdings]].{{cite news |title=Tata Tech sells 13% stake for Rs 141 cr to Alpha TC, TCGF |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/tata-tech-sells-13-stake-for-rs-141-cr-to-alpha-tc-tcgf/articleshow/8155096.cms |access-date=11 May 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=3 May 2011}} In April 2013, Tata Technologies acquired Cambric Corporation, an American engineering services company, for $32.5 million.{{cite news |title=Tata Technologies to acquire US-based firm Cambric for $32.5 million |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/tata-technologies-to-acquire-us-based-firm-cambric-for-32-5-million/articleshow/19740198.cms |access-date=11 May 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=26 April 2013}} In May 2017, Tata Technologies acquired 100% stake in Swedish automotive design and product engineering company, Escenda Engineering AB.{{cite news |title=Tata Technologies acquires Swedish Escenda Engineering |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/tata-technologies-acquires-swedish-escenda-engineering/58574511 |access-date=2 December 2023 |work=Economic Times |language=en}} In 2017, in an effort to reduce Tata Motors' debt, the [[Tata Group]] announced that it would sell a 43% stake in Tata Technologies to private equity firm [[Warburg Pincus]] for $360 million and cease to be the controlling shareholder in the company.{{cite news |last1=Ghoshal |first1=Devjyot |title=Tata Technologies: One of the best-kept secrets of the Tata Group is leaving the mothership |url=https://qz.com/india/1007745/tata-technologies-one-of-the-best-kept-secrets-of-the-tata-group-is-leaving-the-mothership |access-date=11 May 2023 |work=Quartz |date=19 June 2017 |language=en}} However, the deal was called off in 2018.{{cite news |last1=Susmit |first1=Sneh |title=Warburg Pincus, Tata Motors call off $360 million stake sale in Tata Technologies |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/5FqMJqtnmB6VHOTmho6CHP/Warburg-Pincus-Tata-Motors-call-off-360-million-stake-sale.html |access-date=11 May 2023 |work=mint |date=5 February 2018 |language=en}} In November 2023, Tata Technologies launched its book-built [[initial public offering]] (IPO) selling shares worth {{INRconvert|3042|c}}, making it Tata Group's first public offering in nearly two decades.{{Cite news |last=Sen |first=Meghna |date=November 22, 2023 |title=Tata Technologies IPO opens: Should you bet on the Tata group's first IPO in 20 years |work=CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/tata-technologies-ipo-opens-know-gmp-should-you-bet-on-tata-group-first-ipo-in-20-years-18379751.htm}} Its shares began trading on [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] on 30 November 2023.{{cite news |title=Tata Technologies makes bumper D-st debut; lists at 140% premium at Rs 1,200 |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/company-stock/story/tata-technologies-makes-bumper-d-st-debut-lists-at-140-premium-at-rs-1200-407676-2023-11-30 |access-date=2 December 2023 |work=Business Today |date=30 November 2023 |language=en}} In 2024, Tata Technologies and [[BMW]], a German automotive manufacturer, formed a [[joint venture]] named BMW TechWorks India.{{Cite web |last=Paul |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/tata-tech-bmw-form-50-50-jv-to-focus-on-software-driven-solutions-124100801326_1.html |archive-date=6 December 2024 |access-date=10 May 2025 |website=Business Standard |url-status=live }} The joint venture will focus on developing software related technology for vehicles and IT Tata Technologies Limited is an Indian multinational corporation and technology company engaged in product engineering, that provides services to automotive and aerospace original equipment manufacturers as well as industrial machinery companies. It is a subsidiary of Tata Motors.
Tata Technologies has its headquarters in Pune and regional headquarters in Detroit, Michigan, United States. As of 2023, the company has a combined global workforce of more than 11,000 employees across its 18 delivery centres in India, North America, Europe and the Asia-Pacific region.
